WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.

6. When learning Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.

7. When learning Adhesives, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives.

8. When learning Timber conversion and seasoning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber conversion and seasoning.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Growth of timber trees, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of timber trees.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Growth of timber trees.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of timber trees.

11. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.

12. When learning Preparation of Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Wood Workshop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hand Tools and equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.

7. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.

9. B — Information and Communication Technology

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.
